house_style: Scientific editorial gouache for Grade 8. Rich tactile paint, deep atmospheric blues, amber directional light from upper left, precise recognizable equipment, confident shapes and subtle pencil detail. assets.name: icon-co2
assets.prompt: Mauna Loa observatory: small white domed buildings and a tall thin measurement mast on black volcanic lava slopes above a sea of white clouds, deep blue sky. All buildings inside central 80 percent.

assets.name: icon-sun

assets.name: icon-volcano

assets.name: icon-fossil
assets.prompt: A recognizable coal-fired electric power plant at dusk: industrial turbine building, two tall slender chimneys, one distinct broad hyperboloid cooling tower releasing a soft white water-vapor plume, and a coal freight train on rails in the foreground. Convincing industrial structure, layered depth, deep blues and amber light from upper left. All equipment within central 75 percent for a 64-pixel circular medallion. No text, numbers, logos or people.
assets.review: Redrawn in cold review for clearer turbine building, cooling tower and coal train; steam is not CO2.

assets.name: icon-temp
assets.prompt: A white louvered weather-station instrument box on four legs in a green grassy field under a wide blue sky. True horizontal louvers, subtle wood detail. Whole box and legs centered inside inner 80 percent.
